reason: Fact 1 (overhang stays part of origin property when a real right exists, registrable as easement) does not answer the question, which states there was no agreement.
Second clause restates 418's own rule (same effects as missing representative consent), so the question embeds its answer and reads contrived.
Whether a 2/3 decision binds a dissenting bondholder also depends on Art. 1176 OR (approval by upper cantonal authority), missing from gold.
Question states delegation was not permitted; fact 2 (authorised delegation, care in choice) answers nothing asked.
Fact 4 (register accessible at any time in Switzerland) answers no part of the question, which asks only which register and what information it holds.
Fact 2 (damages if contractor at fault) answers nothing asked; the question only asks about free repair and third-party repair at contractor cost.
Question states a medical exam is required, so the 14-day general binding period (fact 1) does not answer it; 4 weeks and start of period suffice.
Fact 1 says 'after at most three calls'; DE/FR/IT all say after three calls. Fix wording; item otherwise sound.
Fact 1 says liquidators must send creditors an extract; IT text of Art. 326 only says compile an extract and keep it available, no sending.
